title: Pocketwire Rewards Member Referral Schedule
content:
The referral bonus of Pocketwire Rewards is set per tier as follows: the points credited when a referred new customer qualifies, the most referral bonuses in one calendar year, the card spend the referred customer must reach and the calendar days after sign-up in which that spend must be reached.

| Tier | Referral bonus (points) | Most referral bonuses per calendar year | Qualifying card spend of the referred customer (USD) | Days after the referred customer's sign-up to reach it (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Rewards Member | 1000 | 5 | 25.00 | 30 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Silver | 1500 | 5 | 25.00 | 30 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Gold | 2000 | 10 | 25.00 | 30 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Platinum | 2500 | 10 | 25.00 | 30 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Diamond | 3000 | 20 | 25.00 | 45 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Obsidian | 5000 | 20 | 25.00 | 60 |

## Notes on the schedule

- The qualifying spend is 25.00 USD on every tier; the time allowed to reach it widens to 45 calendar days on Diamond and 60 calendar days on Obsidian.
- The yearly count is per calendar year: a Gold member can receive at most 10 referral bonuses between 1 January and 31 December.
